      What this desk covers

      • Sample content. Written for this prototype; not reviewed by a groomer or a vet.
      • Not veterinary advice. Nothing here diagnoses or treats.
      • Stop signs on every guide. Each one says when to stop.

      This desk covers routine home grooming for healthy adult dogs: brushing, bathing, mats, nails, ears and teeth. It stops where a groomer or a vet starts.

      Call your vet or a groomer for pain, a wound, a smelly ear, bleeding that will not stop, or a mat tight to the skin.
